title: Any holder of 1% of circulating OBEX can force a reviewed amendment proposal without holding any role
content:
A.6.1.1.5.2.2.2.2.1.2.1.1 states that "The Root Edit process begins with a OBEX token holder submitting a proposal through the Powerhouse system containing a draft Artifact Edit Proposal. A OBEX token holder must hold at least 1% of the circulating token supply to submit a proposal. The proposal must also be posted on the Sky Forum under the 'Obex Prime' category."

Two things are established. First, the right to initiate constitutional change is a **property right, not an office**: no Facilitator, Foundation or GovOps role is required, only stake. Second, initiation is not merely permitted but *effective* — once submitted, A.6.1.1.5.2.2.2.2.1.2.1.3 obliges the Operational Facilitator to review within seven days and to publish a finding either way.

That deadline is what converts the right into leverage. A holder cannot be ignored into silence; the worst available outcome is a published misalignment finding with stated reasoning, which is itself a governance event that others can contest in the Forum.

The 1% threshold and the mandatory public posting work together as an anti-spam filter: costly enough to deter frivolous submissions, low enough that no single party holds a monopoly on initiation. The dual-venue requirement — Powerhouse submission *and* Forum post — also ensures that a proposal cannot progress through the formal system without a public trace.
description: Proposal rights attach to stake rather than office, and the Operational Facilitator is bound to a seven-day review deadline once a compliant proposal is submitted.
